sections.kicker: Prepared for Secret Supper by Atla · November 2026
sections.lead: We looked at your site the way a new customer would. Here is what stood out, in order of weight.
sections.thesis: Secret Supper has one of the most ownable names in its category and a front door that never mentions it.
sections.keep: The photograph. Strangers at one long table in a vineyard is the whole idea in a single image.

pins.what: The headline is the only sentence on the page.
pins.why: It could belong to a wellness retreat, a yoga studio or a candle brand. Nothing in it says dinner or secret.
pins.how: Write one line that only a supper where you do not know the location or the guests could say.
pins.label: Your headline
pins.cost: Anyone who reads the tagline cannot tell Secret Supper from the next gathering.

pins.area: The secret supper wordmark at top left, set in a soft lowercase serif over the vineyard photo
pins.what: The name suggests mystery, the type is a soft script, and the page reveals everything.
pins.why: A secret is the brand's strongest idea, and the front door explains it away.
pins.how: Let the name set the tone: what is withheld should be part of the first screen.
pins.label: Your name
pins.cost: The name does the work and then the page undoes it.

pins.area: Guests seated along a long wooden table in a vineyard at dusk, wearing coats
pins.what: Guests face each other across a long table, in coats, at dusk, with no staging.
pins.why: This is the experience itself and no competitor shows an evening this specific.
pins.how: Make this scene the identity: one setting, one light, one table, used everywhere.
pins.label: Your hero photo
pins.cost: The best proof of the brand is photographed once and then left to sit behind the headline.
